title: Careers in the Future
text:
Many people will change careers several times during their working lives. In the future, jobs in technology, healthcare, and renewable energy are expected to grow quickly. As a result, workers will need to learn new skills regularly. Employers often prefer candidates who can adapt to changing conditions.

Some experts believe that artificial intelligence will automate routine tasks. However, they also argue that it will create new roles that require creativity and judgement. Schools and universities are therefore encouraging students to develop problem-solving and communication skills. Lifelong learning, once a choice, is becoming a necessity.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, which fields are expected to grow quickly?
According to the second paragraph, what do some experts believe artificial intelligence will do?
What can be inferred about employers from the first paragraph?
options: They value workers who can adapt
They avoid hiring people who learn
They prefer workers who never change jobs
They do not care about new skills

questions.text: Why are schools encouraging students to develop problem-solving skills?
options: Because creative, human-centred roles may be needed as automation grows
Because problem-solving is no longer useful
Because students must stop using technology

vocabulary.definition: to change your behaviour to suit new conditions
to make a process work by machines without human effort
a regular, usual way of doing things
something that is essential and cannot be avoided

paragraph_translations: Birçok insan çalışma hayatı boyunca birkaç kez meslek değiştirecek. Gelecekte teknoloji, sağlık ve yenilenebilir enerji alanındaki işlerin hızla büyümesi bekleniyor. Bu nedenle çalışanların düzenli olarak yeni beceriler öğrenmesi gerekecek. İşverenler genellikle değişen koşullara uyum sağlayabilen adayları tercih ediyor.

Bazı uzmanlar yapay zekânın rutin görevleri otomatikleştireceğine inanıyor. Ancak onlar, bunun yaratıcılık ve muhakeme gerektiren yeni roller de yaratacağını savunuyor. Okullar ve üniversiteler bu yüzden öğrencileri problem çözme ve iletişim becerileri geliştirmeye teşvik ediyor. Bir zamanlar bir tercih olan yaşam boyu öğrenme artık bir zorunluluk hâline geliyor.
